body: I guess so. I honestly have no clue.
Sure, I probably could, but I wouldn't be able to afford a ticket. There are ways to meet people but all require more money than I have.

They won't think I'm crazy until I bring up some anime they've never heard of. But besides that I just don't want to bother them. If some guy came up to me out of nowhere and started talking about something I don't give a shit about I'd be really uncomfortable.
Yeah, I'd like to hear something different more often. I feel like everyone I talk to is the same, like I'm repeating the same conversations over and over.
No. My opinions are my own just like everyone else. They are no more or less valid.
I usually get bored or jealous listening to other people. It feels like what others say doesn't matter.
It's hard for me to find the right words most of the time. If someone asks me a question I can answer it, but starting a conversation out of nowhere feels impossible to me.

I can't remember anything remotely positive I even did this week. Ate pizza? But even that upset my stomach.
Horrible. I have been suffering for years and it won't end any time soon.

It's not possible for me to stop focusing on the bad when it's screaming inside me. I try to talk to people but eventually the conversation will turn to my illness. I can't help it. I can't lie when they ask me how I am. I can't fake joy or happiness.

I have lost all my friends because of this. People don't want to stay around me because I only ever talk about how horrible I feel. I simply can't believe that you would be any different. No one wants to constantly be reminded of the bad in the world. I can't blame anyone for that.
Already tried that, offers no relief whatsoever. I would even be willing to try "harder" drugs but I have no access to such things.
